clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Bartleby guards the mug a young warrior must claim. The instructors send recruits to face him in a bare-knuckle fight and earn the vessel for their training.

Stormwind's warrior instructors expect recruits to face combat without excuses or grand ceremony. As part of their formal training, young warriors must retrieve a particular mug from Bartleby, a notorious drunkard who lounges in the city. He scoffs at polite requests and swears no one will take his prized drinkware without prying it from his cold, dead fingers. For a fledgling warrior, words soon give way to a fistfight.

Bartleby boasts that he will fight to the death, but a thorough thrashing is enough to sober him. Once beaten, his bravado gives way to bruised admiration. He recognizes that his opponent is tougher than they appear and yields peacefully, letting the victor claim the mug and complete the trial at the training hall.
